how_to_read: Python packages: the exact wheel files for Windows x64 / CPython 3.12 (the offline package) and Linux x86_64 / CPython 3.12, versions from offline/constraints.txt. sha256 / md5 / blake2b_256 are the digests PyPI publishes for the file the maintainers uploaded (https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/<version>/json). Every file was downloaded and its SHA-256 compared.

Browser libraries: bundled in app/static/vendor. integrity (SHA-512, SRI format) and shasum (SHA-1) are published by the npm registry for the release tarball; every bundled file is byte-identical to the file in that tarball (SHA-256 listed). Bootstrap also publishes SRI (SHA-384) hashes for its files – they match.

Python itself: python.org publishes only an MD5 (plus Sigstore and GPG signatures) for 3.12.10; the SHA-256 shown is computed from the installer in the offline package, whose MD5 and size match python.org.
Development / build items are not part of the installed application.
